title: ChitCreditScoreResponse
description: Canonical contract for Chit Credit Score response payload

member_id.description: Unique identifier of the chit circle member

on_time_pct.description: Percentage of lifetime contributions made on or before the due date

streak_count.description: Current consecutive count of on-time chit contributions

tenure_cycles.description: Number of completed chit fund cycles or tenure milestones

score_value.description: Normalized Chit Credit Score clamped between 0 and 100

score_band.description: Credit tier classification derived deterministically from score_value

breakdown.description: Additive, explainable breakdown of score formula components
